tasks.short: Assist and safeguard patients during delegated activities

steps.what: Instruct, motivate and safeguard patients during delegated exercises

tasks.design: Keep direct patient assistance with the aide under the existing therapist's direction. No software step replaces observation, motivation or physical safeguarding.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on the patient's changing response and direct support.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology is needed for the delegated interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising difficulty and communicating concerns within the aide's delegated role.
tasks.human_edge: The aide notices discomfort, responds to the person and provides direct support.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in delegated responsibility or time allocation.

reach.task: Prepare and support a delegated functional activity

evidence.claim: Direct patient assistance and safeguarding remain hands-on work; no labour reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is the aide's delegated assistance during activity, excluding clinical treatment planning and separate documentation.

The therapist supplies activity instructions before the interaction; the aide confirms understanding during existing handoff and observes responses during s1. No new structured capture or automatic action is proposed.
No custom build; existing clinical facilities remain in use.
Zero incremental upkeep because the workflow adds no component or recurring work.
research_questions: Which practical barriers prevent aides from giving delegated patients timely direct support?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; direct patient support remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with therapy staff about patient information

steps.what: Discuss patient information and clarify treatment coordination with therapy staff

tasks.design: Retain the aide's discussion with therapy staff using the existing information in {DOCS}. The therapist makes clinical planning decisions and clarifies the aide's delegated actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient observations need context and questions before they inform treatment coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component is proposed for the clinical discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Making sure important observations are understood without assigning clinical decisions to the aide.
tasks.human_edge: The aide can clarify exactly what was observed and ask about uncertain instructions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in clinical or delegated decision rights.

reach.task: Give a clear observation handoff within delegated duties
reach.learn: Relevant observation language and escalation practice

evidence.claim: Contextual patient-information discussion remains human work; no conversation saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is the aide's participation in discussion, not the therapist's clinical treatment decision. The therapist's normal participation is unchanged outside the focal labour denominator.
The aide brings existing observations; staff provide questions and clarify instructions during s1. This introduces no new structured form, recording or unpaid staff preparation.
Use existing records and communication facilities; no custom build.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new component or recurring process is introduced.
research_questions: Which recurring handoff questions reveal missing observations or unclear delegation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. The discussion and clinical staff's existing work are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe patient responses and report to the therapist

steps.what: Observe patients during treatment and compile response observations
Evaluate observed changes within delegated duties and report to therapist

tasks.design: Keep observation and the response handoff with the aide. Existing records in {DOCS} support the report, while clinical interpretation remains with the therapist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient response is situational and may need immediate clarification.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component is proposed for direct observation and reporting.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing subtle changes and separating observations from clinical conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: The aide sees the activity in context and can explain what changed.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in observation or reporting responsibility.

reach.task: Report responses during a delegated functional activity
reach.learn: Observation scope and concise handoff practice

evidence.claim: Observation and contextual reporting remain human work; no new labour reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is observing a treatment episode and reporting responses, excluding treatment decisions and separate formal clinical documentation. Related conference work must not count the same handoff twice.
The therapist provides observation instructions; the aide produces observations in s1 and reports them in s2. No automatic progress score, new recording or structured data feed is assumed.
Use existing documentation facilities; no custom build.
Zero incremental upkeep because no additional component is introduced.
research_questions: Which response observations are difficult to convey accurately through current handoffs?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; observation and reporting remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Handle supply and telephone clerical duties

steps.what: Take supply inventory and record current quantities
Prepare and place authorised routine supply orders
Answer telephone calls, clarify messages and route care questions
Complete and check routine administrative forms

tasks.design: Configure routine supply-order suggestions in {PROCUREMENT} and administrative form prefill in the practice records system in {OTHER}. The aide retains physical counts, telephone conversations and exact order and form checks; care questions go to the therapist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated item and administrative field entry sits alongside calls and physical supply counts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order suggestions and form templates can reuse explicitly checked fields.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect stock units, outdated patient details and messages requiring clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The aide clarifies callers' needs, verifies real stock and recognises questions for the therapist.
tasks.altitude: A little less repeated clerical entry; patient-facing duties and delegated limits remain unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare a checked administrative record handoff
reach.learn: Administrative field definitions and access limits

evidence.claim: Configured reorder suggestions and administrative prefill are plausible; these clerical savings are unmeasured and do not cover patient care.

assumptions: Boundary is the aide's inventory, routine ordering, calls and forms, excluding supplier fulfilment, clinical advice and formal treatment documentation.

In s1 the aide captures item identifier, location, counted quantity and unit; all physical counting and capture stay counted. The practice administrator supplies existing authorised item, supplier, pack size, reorder point and spending limit rules. Additional rule checking is costed as other-role upkeep; absent rules require manual ordering in s2, never inferred par levels.

The aide captures caller identity, verified contact details, message facts and destination during s3. Existing practice registration staff produce the patient identifier and demographic record during normal registration. s4 checks these exact fields against the required form; missing, mismatched or clinical content is completed manually or referred, never inferred.

OTHER means the practice administrative records system. Try native prefill and procurement settings before custom code. No labour saving from existing automatic runtime; no additional staff data-entry transfer is assumed.
unknowns: Current prefill coverage and administrative record quality
research_questions: Do order suggestions and form prefill save time after counts, identity checks, corrections and upkeep?

Exact completed administrative form, patient identifier and internal destination; changes void approval
